testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, explicit on interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for React components, NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Implement full Python CLI script content download and copy-to-clipboard functionality.
The bonmont.com URL endpoint pattern MUST check http status/redirect query parameter 'opinions-login-error=invalid_email' to flag email as invalid.
Include real batch processing state management (processing chunk by chunk with delay control or concurrency slider).
Provide sample CSV/TXT file download for user testing directly from the UI.
Ensure high accessibility standards with explicit APCA contrast ratios, key focus outlines, and Sonner notifications for actions.
